name: ai-feature-eval-harness
description: Design an eval plan for a product AI feature: success criteria, a held-out labeled dataset, per-criterion grading (code-based, then LLM-based), and a pass threshold. Use when a task ships or changes a feature with non-deterministic model output (classification, extraction, summarization, ranking, agent action) needing a repeatable dataset eval, not only example tests. Do not use for non-model features (use test-strategy), Fhorja's own command outputs (use verify-against-rubric), or with no task folder.
